description: Which cancellation or change tier applies at this moment, and what does it cost? — Given a booking start, the moment of change, the booking amount and a tiered policy whose deadlines are either elapsed hours before start ('48 hours') or local calendar days at a local time ('18:00 the day before' in the venue's zone, DST-correct), returns the applicable tier, its deadline instants, the penalty in minor units under your stated rounding, and when the next tier begins; checks an ass

changeAt.description: The moment of cancellation/change; never read from the clock.

noShowTier.description: Tier name charged when changeAt is after startAt; default the most severe tier.

daysBefore.description: ...later than the local date of start minus this many days at atLocalTime.

hoursBefore.description: This tier applies when the change is later than start minus this many hours. Exactly one of hoursBefore or daysBefore.

penaltyBps.description: Percent of the amount in basis points. Exactly one of penaltyBps or penaltyMinor.

name: booking-change-penalty
